analysis.summary: Alivus Life Sciences reported Q1 FY27 revenue of INR 640 crores, up 6.4% year-on-year, driven by strong non-GPL growth that offset a decline in the GPL business due to inventory rationalization. Gross margins improved to 60.2% and EBITDA margins expanded to 36.6%, supported by a favorable product mix, new launches, and operational efficiencies. Management guides for a 10% to 12% revenue growth and EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range for FY27, with performance skewed towards the second half of the year. The company remains debt-free with strong cash equivalents and continues to make steady progress on its Solapur capex and R&D pipelines. Alivus Life Sciences reported its financial performance for Q1 FY27, noting revenue of 6,404 million INR and an EBITDA margin of 36.6%.

guidance.claim: The company guides for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY27.
guidance.quote: With a continued strong growth momentum in the non-GPL portfolio and muted growth in the GPL business, we remain confident of achieving revenue growth of 10% - 12% in FY27, while sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30%–32% range.

guidance.claim: GPL business is expected to be flattish for the full year FY27.
guidance.quote: GPL business is expected to be flattish in FY27, despite a significant decline in Q1FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects to sustain EBITDA margins in the range of 30% to 32% going forward.
guidance.quote: However, we remain confident in the strength of our business fundamentals and our ability to sustain EBITDA margins in the range of 30% to 32% going forward.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish for FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: While growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27, the business has been historically weighted towards the second half of the year and we expect a similar trend to play out this year, resulting in a stronger H2 performance.

demand_outlook.claim: The non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year driven by new product launches and demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: Geographically, the company experienced broad-based growth across all markets during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Geographically, we saw broad-based growth across all markets during the quarter, highlighting the strength of the diversified business.

demand_outlook.claim: CDMO business saw a growth of 3.8% YoY in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: CDMO business saw a growth of 3.8% YoY in Q1FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: For the company's markets and portfolio, the pricing environment has been reasonably stable to begin with.
demand_outlook.quote: See, for our markets and our portfolio, the pricing environment has been reasonably stable to begin with.

demand_outlook.claim: The non-GPL business is growing at double digit.
demand_outlook.quote: See, in the non-GPL business, we are already growing at double digit so thing is that the GPL business is a bit wavy.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a significant volume growth in all segments of the business.
demand_outlook.quote: So, see, there's a significant volume growth in all segments of our business.

capex_expansion.claim: Solapur is progressing as planned and is expected to be operational in early Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capex front, Solapur continues to progress as planned. There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction at the Taloja R&D center has begun and will proceed on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction at Taloja, the R&D center has begun in earnest, and it will happen on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex for Q1 stood at INR 85 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow moment, our capex for the quarter stood at INR85 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to incur a capex of approximately INR 540 crores in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: A brownfield expansion is planned in Ankleshwar for an addition of approximately 100 KL capacity in Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Brownfield API / Intermediate Ankleshwar Planned addition of ~100KL Capacity Q4 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Greenfield expansion at Solapur Phase 1 is planned for approximately 350 KL in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 - ~350 KL (API and Backward Integration) Q3 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Greenfield expansion at Solapur Phase 3 has a planned addition of approximately 535 KL in FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 3 - Planned addition of ~535 KL FY29

capex_expansion.claim: Solapur Phase 1 is progressing as planned and is expected to be operational in Q2 of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capex front, Solapur Phase 1 is progressing as planned and is expected to be operational in Q2 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new R&D center in Taloja in Navi Mumbai is underway.
capex_expansion.quote: While construction of the new R&D center in Taloja in Navi Mumbai is also underway.

capex_expansion.claim: Planned capacity additions will take total capacity from 1,198 KL in FY24 to 2,690 KL by FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The capacity we are adding today will take us from 1,198 KL in FY24 to a planned 2,690 KL by FY28, positioning the company to drive sustained growth well beyond FY28.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins improved to 60.2%, an increase of 510 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On the profitability front, a favourable product mix and newer launches helped improve gross margins to 60.2%, an increase in 510 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved by 650 basis points year-on-year to 36.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains also supported 650 basis points Y-o-Y improvement in EBITDA margins to 36.6%.

margins_costs.claim: R&D expenditure for Q1 FY27 was INR 24 crores, representing 3.7% of sales.
margins_costs.quote: R&D expenditure for Q1 FY '27 was INR24 crores, which was 3.7% of our sales.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter reached 36.6%, up 220 bps QoQ and 650 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA Margins for the quarter were at 36.6%, up 220 bps QoQ & 650 bps YoY, signifying better operational efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for the quarter were at 25.0%, up 140 bps QoQ and 480 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margins for the quarter were at 25.0% up 140 bps QoQ & 480 bps YoY.

margins_costs.claim: A loss due to fire at Dahej of INR20 crores was booked in other expenses.
margins_costs.quote: From an expense perspective, yes, we have booked a loss due to fire in our other expenses to the extent of INR20 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins for Q4 FY26 stood at 60.7%, up 420 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margins for the quarter stood at 60.7%, up 420 basis points year-on-year, driven by new launches, product mix and operational efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: Solvents contribute about 12% to 13% to overall costs.
margins_costs.quote: The good thing is that solvents contribute about 12%, 13% to our overall cost.

orders_capacity.claim: The product pipeline remains robust with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as of June 30.
orders_capacity.quote: The pipeline remains robust, with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30.

orders_capacity.claim: The high-potent API portfolio has 29 products in the active grid representing a TAM of $82 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high-potent API portfolio continues to advance with 29 products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $82 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: Total cumulative DMF and CEP filings reached 617 as of June 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: DMF/CEP filings continue across major markets in Q1FY27, taking the total cumulative filings to 617 as on 30th June 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The current portfolio stands at 176 unique molecules following the addition of 11 new products during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have added 11 new products during the year, and the current portfolio stands at 176 unique molecules.

orders_capacity.claim: The customer base increased by 49 new customers during FY26 to reach about 900.
orders_capacity.quote: We have also added 49 new customers during FY26, taking our total base of customers to about 900.

orders_capacity.claim: The pipeline includes over 611 DMF and CEP filings globally as of March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our pipeline remains robust with over 611 DMF and CEP filings globally as on March 31, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The high potent API portfolio has 28 products in the pipeline, with 12 validated, 7 in advanced stages of development, and 9 progressing through land development stages.
orders_capacity.quote: The high potent API portfolio remains on the development path with 28 products in the pipeline. 12 of these products are validated, seven products are in advanced stages of development and the remaining Nine products are progressing well through land development stages.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated a strong free cash flow of INR 90 crores in the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated a strong free cash flow of INR90 crores, leading to cash and cash equivalents including short-term investments of INR880 crores as of 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Alivus continues to remain a debt-free company.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a debt-free company.

capital_allocation.claim: Capex for FY27 is planned at about INR540 crores, funded entirely through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Looking ahead to FY27, we plan to incur a capex of about INR540 crores, which includes carryover commitments from FY26 as well as fresh capital investments. Importantly, this entire capex will be funded through internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and cash equivalents stood at INR782 crores as of March 31, 2026, with full year capex at INR306 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 31st March 2026, our cash and cash equivalents stood at INR782 crores, with capex for the year being INR306 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Over the last 2 years, the company generated cash from operations of about INR984 crores, invested INR472 crores in capex, paid INR61 crores in dividends, and maintained a net debt-free position.
capital_allocation.quote: Over the last 2 years, we have generated cash from operations of about INR984 crores, of which we have invested in capex of INR472 crores, paid dividend of INR61 crores and resulted in a war chest of INR 451 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: GPL business performance was muted due to inventory rationalization resulting in a year-on-year decline.
risks_headwinds.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization. And so if you recall, Q4 was pretty strong, and we saw a dip in Q1, a decline of 52.6% year-on-year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management remains watchful of the evolving geopolitical and demand environment due to war situations affecting raw material prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: So while we remain watchful of the evolving geopolitical and demand environment, the strength of our business fundamentals gives us confidence in our growth outlook.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties that could cause actual outcomes to differ materially.
risks_headwinds.quote: These statements are based on current expectations, forecasts and assumptions that are subject to risks and uncertainties which could cause actual outcomes and results to differ materially from these statements.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited uncertainties around tariffs, regulatory shifts, supply chain disruptions, and elevated logistics and energy costs as headwinds.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this period, we have faced some headwinds like uncertainties around tariffs and regulatory shifts. These factors continue to disrupt supply chain, elevated logistics and energy costs and created uncertainty across global markets, making resilience and agility increasingly critical.

risks_headwinds.claim: The fire at Dahej impacted only the intermediate side of the facility, leaving the API finished area intact.
risks_headwinds.quote: So the fire at Dahej impacted only the intermediate side of the facility. The API, the finished area was intact.
